title: refactor(app-shell): move ObjectView's view management handlers into a sibling hook (slice 11b)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VtKf3F9dzJPJM4RRtABaEc)_


Fixes #25992 (slice 11b, the last slice of the move-only split; slices 1 to 11a landed as #26152, #26233, #26310, #26336, #26353, #26374, #26396, #26412, #26434 and #26492). With this PR, every region of the seam table in #26336 that was marked for a slice has moved; what stays in `ObjectView.tsx` is the shared state (A, C, F, J), the panel and dialog state, the hook calls and the JSX.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What moved

Base `a2e4b760` (the branch's merge of `main` at `73683ee1`, slice 11a merged). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` is 1480 lines there. Three blocks of `ObjectViewInner` move verbatim into one custom hook, `useObjectViewViewCrud`, in the new sibling module `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`. Every input is passed as an argument, typed from its source (no `any`), and the component destructures the 13 handlers under their original names. No identifier is renamed and no context is added.

- **B: the view-config save and create doors** (lines 228–371). The objectui#12504 note on the retired `persistViewPatch`, the objectui#4155 block comment on the absent `persistViewFilter`, `handleViewConfigSave` and `handleViewCreate`, with their docblocks and dependency lists.
- **B: `handleViewUpdate`** (lines 789–796), the panel's draft field update, with its docblock.
- **I: view switching and the view-tab CRUD callbacks** (lines 798–1002). `handleViewChange`, the mobile view switcher items and `useMobileViewSwitcherRegistration`, `handleCreateView`, `handleViewAction`, `isSavedView`, `handleRenameView`, `handleDeleteView`, `handlePinView`, `handleSetDefaultView`, the objectui#12418 docblock and `handleReorderViews`, `handleConfigView` and `handleAddView`.

The hook is called where `handleViewUpdate` stood, after `useObjectViewListUrlState`. It returns `handleViewConfigSave`, `handleViewCreate`, `handleViewUpdate`, `handleViewChange`, `handleCreateView`, `handleViewAction`, `handleRenameView`, `handleDeleteView`, `handlePinView`, `handleSetDefaultView`, `handleReorderViews`, `handleConfigView` and `handleAddView`. `isSavedView` and the mobile switcher items stay inside the hook, their only readers.

**What stays.** The five `useState` calls of B (`showViewConfigPanel`, `viewConfigPanelMode`, `showCreateViewDialog`, `manageViewsOpen`, `viewDraft`, lines 217–226) stay in the component. `activeView` (F, line 758) reads `viewDraft` before the hook's inputs exist, and the JSX reads the panel and dialog flags. The hook receives the setters.

**Hook order.** `handleViewConfigSave` and `handleViewCreate` (two `useCallback`s) used to run before the record count state, `useAuth` and every hook down to `useObjectViewListUrlState`. They now run after it, inside the new hook, right before `handleViewUpdate`. They could not be called at their old spot: their bodies call `setRefreshKey`, declared at line 401, so passing it to a hook there would hit the TDZ. Nothing between their old and new positions reads them (measured: no reference between lines 372 and 788). The hooks of `handleViewUpdate` and I keep their order and position. The seat's ruling allows this shift when stated.

### Imports

Each import moves with its only readers: `formatMetadataError`, `viewTabLabel`, `persistRuntimeMetadata` / `createRuntimeMetadata` / `viewEnvelope`, `PREVIEW_QUERY_FLAG` / `PREVIEW_QUERY_VALUE`, `useMobileViewSwitcherRegistration`, `MobileViewSwitcherItem`, `isSavedViewId`, `buildAddViewSpec`, `setDefaultViewPatches`, `buildViewConfigSaveBody` and `dispatchViewPatches`. These names are still re-exported from `ObjectView.tsx` where they were before, and those lines are unchanged. Names the component still reads elsewhere (`useCallback`, `useMemo`, `toast`, `VIEW_TYPE_ICONS`) are imported by the module as well. Nothing new is exported from `ObjectView.tsx`, and the package entry is untouched. `ObjectView.tsx` goes from 1480 to 1151 lines.

Move-only proof: the multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectView.tsx` is contained in the new `ObjectView.tsx` plus the module, except 9 lines. Every one of the 9 is an import line or an import-list entry that lost a moved name: the `PREVIEW_QUERY_FLAG` and `PREVIEW_QUERY_VALUE` entries, the `../utils/viewIdentity.js` import (replaced by its trimmed form), the `buildAddViewSpec`, `setDefaultViewPatches` and `buildViewConfigSaveBody` entries of the `./objectViewTabs.js` list, and the three-line `./objectViewOptions.js` import of `dispatchViewPatches`. The module imports each of those names itself. The added lines are:
- the trimmed import and the new import;
- the module header and imports;
- the hook signature and parameter types;
- the `return`;
- in `ObjectView.tsx`, the call with its destructuring and a two-line comment.

## Test edits

Five source-scan readers move to the file that now holds what they read. Each edit is a path or file-list change, and no assertion changed:

1. `writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`: the six `LEDGER` rows for `handleViewConfigSave`, `handleViewCreate`, `handleRenameView`, `handleDeleteView`, `handlePinView` and `handleSetDefaultView` change `file: 'ObjectView.tsx'` to `file: 'objectViewViewCrud.tsx'`. Callees, counts, pins and reasons are unchanged. The census walks `views/`, so it finds the sites in the new file.
2. `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts`: the `deleteViewConfirm` row of the deleted-fallbacks list → `packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewViewCrud.tsx`. Its absent and present markers are unchanged.
3. `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly.test.ts`: the joined `objectViewCode` list gains `'objectViewViewCrud.tsx'`. The control's `handleViewConfigSave` and `persistRuntimeMetadata` reads are there now.
4. `view-filter-fold.ratchet.test.ts`: the joined `objectViewSrc` list gains `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, for the `handleViewConfigSave` initializer the ratchet parses.
5. `ObjectView.unboundAdapterCall.test.ts`: the detach-then-call ratchet reads `ObjectView.tsx` and `objectViewViewCrud.tsx` joined, the same way as the two above. Without this edit it would still pass, but it would no longer read `handleSetDefaultView` and `handlePinView`, the handlers it guards.

Edit 5 is the one the seat's list did not name. It is listed for the same reason as the others: the scan's subject moved.

## Seam table rows this PR changes (measured on `a2e4b760`)

The full table (regions A to Q) is in #26336.

| # | Concern | Lines on `a2e4b760` | Reads | Read by | Slice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B (state) | Panel and dialog open state, `viewDraft` | 217–226 | — | F, H, I, N, O, P, Q | stays (shared state) |
| B | `handleViewConfigSave`, `handleViewCreate` and their notes | 228–371 | A, C (`setRefreshKey`) | Q | **11b, this PR** |
| B | `handleViewUpdate` | 789–796 | B (`setViewDraft`), F (`baseView`) | Q | **11b, this PR** |
| I | View switching, mobile switcher, view-tab CRUD callbacks | 798–1002 | A, B, C, F | N, Q | **11b, this PR** |

## Verification

The full readings are in the os-dev-report comment on the card:
- app-shell `type-check` after rebuilding its dependency closure;
- 208 test files: every `ObjectView.*` test in `views/` (the view CRUD, refusal, create-view, default-view, view-config save and mobile FAB tests among them), the `AppContent*` tests, and every other test that reads `ObjectView.tsx` as source, including the five re-pointed ones;
- eslint on the touched files;
- the derived dispatch gates;
- a Console build.

## Acceptance notes

- eslint: 0 errors, and no new `no-explicit-any`. `ObjectView.tsx` plus the module report 83 warnings, against 80 for the base `ObjectView.tsx` alone.
  - Added: 10 `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` warnings in the module, and 1 existing one (the `objectName` warning on `handleDeleteView`) now also names `setRefreshKey`. Each added warning names a state setter that is now a hook parameter (`setRefreshKey`, `setViewDraft`, `setShowViewConfigPanel`, `setViewConfigPanelMode`, `setShowCreateViewDialog`). The rule treats a `useState` setter as stable only in the component that declares it. The dependency lists are kept verbatim, because adding the setters would change code; the setters are stable, so behaviour is the same. Slice 8 drew the same class of warning at its hook boundary.
  - Gone: the 2 `exhaustive-deps` warnings on `handleViewChange`, the 4 `preserve-manual-memoization` skips on these handlers, and 1 `react-hooks/immutability` finding (`handleViewConfigSave` reading `setRefreshKey` before its declaration).
  - Unchanged: the other `exhaustive-deps` warnings (`listPrefs` in `handleReorderViews`, and the two on the `objectDef` effect) only moved lines.
  - Net: 80 + 10 − 2 − 4 − 1 = 83.
- The test edits add no warning.

Changeset: `.changeset/25992-objectview-view-crud-split.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).
